career_ladder.note: Assam Rifles is India's oldest paramilitary force, operating under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs and operational control of the Ministry of Defence (Indian Army). Recruits in the Technical and Tradesmen cadre enter across ranks ranging from Rifleman (Level 3) to Warrant Officer (Level 5) and Naib Subedar (Level 6), advancing through Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) ranks based on service exams, technical trade evaluations, and annual performance appraisals.

exam_scheme.note: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesmen Recruitment Rally is conducted on-site in North Eastern centres (Shillong, Diphu, Dimapur, Silchar, Haflong) through four successive phases: Phase 1 Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET); Phase 2 Trade (Skill) Test; Phase 3 Written Examination (100 marks, 100 questions, 2 hours); Phase 4 Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME).

financial_package.note: Pay scale for Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesmen cadre follows the 7th CPC. Core entry trade positions (Rifleman GD and technical trades) start in Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100), while Havildar (Clerk) is Level 4 (₹25,500) and Warrant Officer is Level 5 (₹29,200). Personnel are entitled to military service allowances and operational hardship allowances in the North East.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian & CAPF Personnel), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 with 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (10% to 30%), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,965/month) and Special Compensatory / Counter-Insurgency Allowances in North-East hill postings, minus NPS contribution.
official_perks: Free ration / Ration Money Allowance in field and garrison postings
Special Duty Allowance (SDA) / Counter-Insurgency Allowance in remote North-East sectors
High Altitude Allowance and Extreme Hardship Allowances in Indo-Myanmar border areas
Free medical attendance through Assam Rifles Composite Hospitals and Military Hospitals
Canteen Stores Department (CSD) / CPC canteen purchasing privileges
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and 60 days annual leave + 15 days casual leave
